summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 2 in Preterit (Jan 1.39/1715)

data.turoyo: <...> Maqəmle i ṭayuṯo aʕlayye, hedi kulayna maqrəfina mene, qaləbinawo hawinawo Xalq Partisi.
data.translation: <...> It roused the Muslims against them. Then we all became disgusted with it, changed sides, and became Halk Party.

rationale: First Detransitive Preterit box and figurative sense 2; collective experiencer and mən- stimulus. Reduced morphology is provisional. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation.

summary: New sense 2: (Detrans.; fig.) Widerwillen, Ekel empfinden (mit mən-)
rationale: Political betrayal and social aversion differ from physical nausea in existing Detransitive sense 1. The mən- stimulus is secure at 1715; no l- government is inferred from the nominal restatement at 5651.

summary: No round 1 job exists for this root. Work from the supplied qrf 2 entry and keep it separate from the break homonym.

Both occurrences describe social aversion rather than bodily sickness. At Jan 1.39/1715 the political sequence anchors onset of disgust and switching allegiance; the collective experiencer is kulayna and stimulus mene.
mtaqrəfina at Jan 2.35/5651 may be a result predicate or unprefixed Infectum. Its repetition as hawi qarafe tarixiye lə kul mede means the l- target cannot securely be assigned to the verb.
The Preterit example maqrəfina reduces the fuller mtaqrəf base. This is a new form-box proposal, with morphological qualification, not a new active causative stem.
Confirm maqrəfina at Jan 1.39/1715 as a reduced III Detransitive Preterit rather than another formation.
At Jan 2.35/5651, distinguish result-state/Preterit mtaqrəfina from unprefixed Infectum and determine whether lə kul mede belongs only to qarafe. No new l- government is published.
